task.title: Reduce project load and cache-state resolution time
task.problem: Every run on freedesktop-sdk sdk.bst (615 elements) spends 24-28 s loading the project and resolving source cache state before any search; that is 75% of a warm-index find (32 s) and the floor for every query.
task.proposal: Profile the load phase (project load, load_selection, update_resolved_state, query_cache, get_files) on freedesktop-sdk; remove avoidable per-element work in the tool, and evaluate a versioned cache of the element-to-source-digest mapping keyed by every input that can change it (project files, options, junction state, cache contents). Never return a stale mapping.
acceptance: A load-phase profile on freedesktop-sdk sdk.bst identifies where the time goes.
Any cached mapping is invalidated by edits to elements, includes, project options, junctions and source cache changes, with tests for each.
Load time on freedesktop-sdk sdk.bst drops measurably with identical results.
